WITH patient_averages AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana
  FROM Examination
  WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg_ana
  FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg_ana AS excess
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg_ana
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
